WITH all_actions AS (
  SELECT parent_id, action FROM "drugbank_targets_actions"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT parent_id, action FROM "drugbank_transporters_actions"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT parent_id, action FROM "drugbank_carriers_actions"
)
SELECT parent_id
FROM all_actions
WHERE LOWER(action) IN ('inhibitor','binder','substrate')
GROUP BY parent_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT LOWER(action)) = 3
LIMIT 50;
